summary: Selector + effect refactor correctly broadens Perps deposit toasts to token-funded deposits (e.g. USDC on Arbitrum) and aligns with mobile's type-only gating. Tests (97/97) and live perps smoke (11/11) pass. One non-blocking suggestion: a back-to-back deposit started within the 5s success-toast timer suppresses the next pending toast.

comments.body: Race window worth tracking (non-blocking): if a new Perps deposit starts before the previous completion's 5s timer elapses, `hasDepositResult` is still truthy here, so this early-return suppresses the pending toast for the new deposit until `perpsClearDepositResult` fires. `clearDepositResult` in `PerpsController` only clears `lastDepositResult` (not `lastDepositTransactionId`), so the gate is strictly the 5s timer. Mobile's `usePerpsDepositStatus` sidesteps this because it tracks a ref + balance-increase instead of a redux-derived priority. Narrow race in practice — leaving as a follow-up note rather than a blocker.
